lines.beaver: 다음이 제 순서예요. 잘할 수 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: I'm up next. Do you think I can do well?
lines.beaver_roman: daeumi je sunseoyeyo. jalhal su isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 민수 씨, 얼굴이 좀 어두워 보여요. 괜찮아요?
lines.en: Minsu, you look a bit down. Are you okay?
lines.roman: minsu ssi, eolguri jom eoduwo boyeoyo. gwaenchanayo?

lines.beaver: 네, 좀 답답해요. 준비가 아직 부족한 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, I feel a bit frustrated. I don't think I'm ready yet.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jom dapdapaeyo. junbiga ajik bujokan geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 사실 아침에 자료를 집에 두고 왔어요.
lines.beaver_en: Actually, I left my materials at home this morning.
lines.beaver_roman: sasil achime jaryoreul jibe dugo wasseoyo.
lines.en: So that's why you looked upset this morning.

lines.beaver_en: I brought them back. I'm worried the manager will get angry.
lines.learner: 팀장님은 잘 화내지 않는 편이에요. 걱정 마세요.
lines.en: The manager doesn't really get angry. Don't worry.
lines.roman: timjangnimeun jal hwanaeji anneun pyeonieyo. geokjeong maseyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 사람들 앞에서 말하면 너무 부끄러워요.
lines.beaver_en: I get so embarrassed speaking in front of people.
lines.beaver_roman: jeoneun saramdeul apeseo malhamyeon neomu bukkeureowoyo.
lines.en: That's natural. My face turned red at first too.

lines.beaver: 지영 씨는 발표를 정말 잘하잖아요. 부러워요.
lines.beaver_en: But you're really good at presentations, Jiyeong. I'm jealous.
lines.beaver_roman: jiyeong ssineun balpyoreul jeongmal jalhajanayo. bureowoyo.
lines.learner: 부러울 거 없어요. 저도 매주 연습했어요.
lines.en: Nothing to envy. I practiced every week too.
lines.roman: bureoul kkeo eopseoyo. jeodo maeju yeonseupaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 연습이 귀찮지 않았어요? 저는 자꾸 그만두고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: Wasn't practicing a pain? I keep wanting to quit.
lines.beaver_roman: yeonseubi gwichanchi anasseoyo? jeoneun jakku geumandugo sipeoyo.
lines.en: It was a pain, but I kept going. Don't quit.

lines.beaver_en: Jiyeong, what happens when you get nervous?
lines.en: I tend to talk fast when I'm nervous.

lines.beaver_en: Me too! So I keep tripping over my words.
lines.en: Just speak slowly and comfortably, like with a friend.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 이제 마음이 좀 편해요. 다녀올게요!
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I feel a bit calmer now. I'm off!
lines.beaver_roman: gomawoyo. ije maeumi jom pyeonhaeyo. danyeoolgeyo!
lines.learner: 지금은 훨씬 밝아 보여요. 잘하고 오세요!
lines.en: You look much brighter now. Go do great!
lines.roman: jigeumeun hwolssin balga boyeoyo. jalhago oseyo!
